text:
alex: Heads-up — we're proposing to remove implicit v1 routing fallbacks at the edge on May 15. See the PR: https://git.redwood/internal/pr/4821 :eyes:
jamal: Why remove the fallback? Customers still hit /v1 and expect identical semantics sometimes.
maria: UX concerns — console currently shows a single model dropdown tied to /v1. If edge stops honoring v1 defaults, console will display errors for old routes.
sre_anna: From SRE side: fallbacks are masking capacity routing bugs. We've seen surprising cross-tenant routing when models were evicted. Removing the implicit mapping will make routing deterministic.
devex_coach: SDKs rely on v1->v2 shim that rewrites some params. If we break the shim, we need clear deprecation warnings and a migration helper in the SDK.
ryan: We should consider a staged rollout: config flag enable_v1_compat at infra level, default true in canary, false in prod after 2 weeks. Also add telemetry events for any rewrite.
alex: Agreed on staged rollout. Plan in PR: 1) add feature flag; 2) emit telemetry; 3) console UX migration banner; 4) flip in canary; 5) flip in prod.
jamal: Two edge cases: 1) quota accounting differences between v1 and v2 token counting; 2) function-calling semantics changed (named parms normalization). Need compatibility matrix.
maria: For console, we can show a migration checklist per customer and an "auto-migrate" toggle that runs the shim in our backend for them for 30 days. That buys time.
sre_anna: Telemetry we need: route_resolution.{attempt,fallthrough,rewrite}, quota.delta, shim.invocations. Add tags: tenant_id, route, flip_id.
devex_coach: SDK helper: detect server telemetry header X-Redwood-Shim: true and print a warning in client logs. Provide a snippet: ```js
if (res.headers.get('x-redwood-shim') === 'true') console.warn('Using v1 shim — migrate to v2. see https://go.redwood/migrate');
```
ryan: Tests: add e2e with 3 routing modes: legacy-shim, strict-v2, hybrid-compat. We should run hybrid-compat in canary for 5k reqs and surface errors in the rollout dashboard.
alex: Deployment notes: deploy-bot will post canary results. @deploy-bot can you include sample failure rate and top 10 affected routes?
deploy-bot: Canary started at 2026-05-01T14:05Z. Will report every 30m. (status: running)
jamal: Also need policy for third-party integrators that rely on behavior bugs. Some will prefer we keep shim permanently behind enterprise plan.
maria: OK to offer a paid "compat SLA" but we must not keep shim enabled by default. That becomes tech debt.
sre_anna: Fallback policy we remove: implicit host->model mapping. Keep explicit aliasing via customer config. Document the old behavior in the migration guide.
devex_coach: One more: telemetry privacy check — ensure shim headers don't leak prompt contents. Only emit counts and flags.
alex: Action items: jamal write compat matrix draft by EOD Fri; ryan add tests and load script; maria draft console banner and migration UI; sre_anna list telemetry events and retention; devex_coach update SDK warning and helper. I'll update the PR with rollout plan and canary schedules.
ryan: I'll also add dashboard widgets: "shim hits", "shim errors", "route mismatch examples" for the rollout page.
jamal: +1. If anyone finds customers heavily using named-params, ping me directly before flip.
maria: I'll coordinate comms with growth. Draft email + in-console banner copy ready for review tomorrow.
alex: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after first canary report. :thumbsup:
